description: List the items added, changed, moved, or deleted in a changeset, label, shelve, or branch, or between two changesets/labels, with Unity .meta pairing warnings. Read-only.

compareTo.description: Optional second changeset, label, or shelve (cs:130, lb:LABEL, sh:12). When set, source is the older side. Not allowed with a branch source.

maxItems.description: Maximum items to return, from 1 to 5000. Default: 500. Counts always cover every item.

source.description: What to inspect: cs:123 (that changeset), lb:LABEL, sh:12, or a branch such as /main/task (all changes made on the branch).

name: uvcs_changeset_diff
